jobs.title: VP/Head of Engineering (all genders)
jobs.desc: Your mission Full technical ownership of Rocket — reporting directly to the founders, with no layer in between In this role you own engineering at MICE DESK — fully. There is no CTO layer above you: architecture, technology, delivery, and team are yours, and you report directly to the founders. This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead the engineering team including our AI/Data function, own the interface to Product, and are accountable for everything that ships. Engineering, end-to-end. Architecture, system design, delivery against the roadmap, reliability, technical debt. Backend, frontend, DevOps, QA, and the AI/Data team all roll up to you. You set lightweight processes that let a small team ship fast without breaking things. An AI-enabled engineering pipeline. We don't just build AI products — we build with AI. You make the engineering organization itself AI-native: agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted review and testing, automation of everything repetitive. A small team should ship like one three times its size — making that true is your job. AI as a core system capability. You architect the integration of LLMs and agentic workflows into production systems: deterministic logic combined with AI-generated outputs, with real validation, fallbacks, and reliability strategies. Hotel operations run on our platform — non-determinism is no excuse for unreliability. The team. Hire, mentor, scale. You inherit a strong small team and grow it into a high-performance engineering organization with a culture of ownership and speed. Our distributed hiring strategy across multiple locations is yours as well. Product and business alignment. You work directly with the founders and Product. You challenge requirements, simplify complexity, and connect engineering work to outcomes: revenue, automation, customer impact. As we enter the US market, engineering has to keep pace with enterprise-scale customers on two continents. What success looks like: 6 months: Delivery is predictable, the AI-enabled dev pipeline is running, and the team has grown with A-players you hired. 12 months: The platform scales with US enterprise customers, core systems are reliable and observable, and engineering is a competitive advantage — not a bottleneck. Honestly: This is full accountability with no net above it. No CTO layer to make or catch decisions — the architecture, the team, and everything that ships are yours. If you want a role where someone above you sets direction, this isn't it. If you want exactly that ownership, it is. Your profile 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in an engineering leadership role at high-growth product companies. Strong hands-on backend or full-stack background — you can still go deep. Proven experience scaling engineering teams at growing startups. Strong architecture expertise: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, cloud. LLM / agentic AI systems in production — and genuine conviction that engineering itself should be AI-assisted. Product mindset: you connect technical decisions to business outcomes. Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and full accountability. Nice to have, not required: Background in hospitality tech, CRM, PMS, or revenue management. Enterprise integration experience (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Experience leading distributed, international teams. Why us? We are the technology company rethinking group and event sales in hospitality. What runs today through inboxes, spreadsheets and phone calls, our platform Rocket turns into one continuous, AI-supported process — from the first enquiry to the signed contract. European hotel groups already run their group sales on it. What that means for you: you work with AI, not despite it. People who join us give feedback that shapes product decisions — and sooner or later come to understand why one prompt works better than another. And because we are growing fast, a lot here is still taking shape. Sometimes the honest answer is “we’re still building that.” That is exactly where the opportunity lies: you will find open space rather than finished structures, and what you build here will carry your signature. What we offer Work with real AI technology at international level — not as a pilot project, but as our business model. Genuine room to shape things. Your ideas do not land in a suggestion box; they land in the next iteration. A short path to the management team. Decisions take days, not committee rounds. Growth you are part of. We are building the company’s next chapter — with roles, responsibility and prospects that did not exist a year ago. Leipzig as your primary base , with regular time in the office and flexible remote work. Hybrid models are everyday practice here, not the exception. Permanent contract, full-time. Performance bonuses for demonstrable results. Multi-day team events in places that are actually fun. Our hiring process Intro interview — we get to know each other, and you learn where we stand and where we are heading. Leadership study or technical study , depending on the role — a real problem from our day-to-day that we work through together. jobs.desc: div class= content-intro h2 WHAT MAKES US EPIC? /h2 p At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating. /p p Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development. /p /div h2 ENGINEERING - GAMES /h2 h3 strong What We Do /strong /h3 p Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide. /p h3 strong What You ll Do /strong /h3 p You will work with our team of applied research engineers at the intersection of computer vision, nbsp; gameplay agents, natural language processing, and machine learning to create state-of-the-art tools to support game developers in our ecosystem with a focus on bots (trained gameplay agents, intelligent NPCs, companions, world modeling), as well as automation of a number key areas (including moderation, security, and QA testing). You will be responsible for the design, implementation and deployment of production-ready machine learning models that can be integrated in our ecosystem. /p h3 strong In this role, you will /strong /h3 ul li Create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality machine learning models and associated algorithms that can make actions in game environments /li li Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap /li li Methodically understand and assess the effectiveness of new data channels and support collection/creation of new ones /li /ul h3 strong What we re looking for /strong /h3 ul li ul li PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience nbsp; /li li Experience creating / applying machine learning algorithms for action modeling of bots behavior, vision-based or language-instructed, and deploying them as production-level systems in-game /li li Expert, hands-on knowledge of: ul li Deep learning, incl. but not limited to applications in the gaming industry /li li Foundational models and vision and/or language, especially nbsp; vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning agents, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models /li li Reinforcement learning, incl. experience with agentic systems, reward design, policy optimisation, evaluation, and building scalable training environments for agents /li li Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch) /li /ul /li li Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible/agile/lean approach /li /ul /li /ul h2 EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE /h2 p span data-sheets-userformat= { quot;2 quot;:13201, quot;3 quot;:{ quot;1 quot;:0}, quot;7 quot;:{ quot;1 quot;:[{ quot;1 quot;:2, quot;2 quot;:0, quot;5 quot;:{ quot;1 quot;:2, quot;2 quot;:13421772}},{ quot;1 quot;:0, quot;2 quot;:0, quot;3 quot;:3},{ quot;1 quot;:1, quot;2 quot;:0, quot;4 quot;:1}]}, quot;10 quot;:0, quot;11 quot;:4, quot;12 quot;:0, quot;15 quot;: quot;Roboto quot;, quot;16 quot;:10} We pay 100% for benefits except for PMI (for dependents). Our current benefits package includes pension, private medical insurance, health care cash plan, dental insurance, disability and life insurance, critical illness, cycle to work scheme, flu shots, health checks, and meals. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees amp; dependents. /span /p div class= content-conclusion h2 ABOUT US /h2 p Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we ve been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic s award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent. /p h3 strong Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! /strong /h3 p Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer.
